# Сценарий сверки: команды отсортированных множеств, score/lex-семейство.

# --- подготовка ---
ZADD z 1 a 2 b 3 c 4 d 5 e
ZADD z 2 aa 2 bb
ZADD lex 0 a 0 aa 0 b 0 bb 0 c

# --- инкременты и чтение ---
ZINCRBY z 1.5 a
ZSCORE z a
ZCOUNT z 2 4
ZCOUNT z (2 +inf
ZCOUNT z -inf +inf
ZMSCORE z a b nosuch
ZLEXCOUNT lex [a [b
ZLEXCOUNT lex - +

# --- диапазоны по score ---
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 2 4
ZRANGEBYSCORE z (2 4
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 2 3 WITHSCORES
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 1 5 LIMIT 1 2
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 1 5 LIMIT 0 3
ZREVRANGEBYSCORE z 4 2
ZREVRANGEBYSCORE z 4 2 WITHSCORES

# --- диапазоны по ZRANGE с опциями ---
ZRANGE z 2 4 BYSCORE
ZRANGE z 4 2 BYSCORE REV
ZRANGE z 0 2 REV
ZRANGE z 0 2
ZRANGE z 2 4 BYSCORE LIMIT 1 2

# --- диапазоны по lex ---
ZRANGEBYLEX lex [a (c
ZRANGEBYLEX lex [a (c LIMIT 1 2
ZREVRANGEBYLEX lex (c [a
ZRANGE lex [a (c BYLEX
ZRANGE lex (c [a BYLEX REV

# --- ошибки ---
ZCOUNT z bad 4
ZCOUNT z 1 bad
ZRANGEBYLEX lex a b
ZLEXCOUNT lex a b
ZRANGEBYSCORE z 1
ZINCRBY z notafloat m

# --- операции над множествами (M15) ---
ZADD a 1 x 2 y
ZADD b 10 x 20 z
ZUNIONSTORE u 2 a b
ZRANGE u 0 -1 WITHSCORES
ZUNIONSTORE uw 2 a b WEIGHTS 2 3
ZRANGE uw 0 -1 WITHSCORES
ZUNIONSTORE um 2 a b AGGREGATE MAX
ZRANGE um 0 -1 WITHSCORES
ZINTERSTORE i 2 a b
ZRANGE i 0 -1 WITHSCORES
ZDIFF 2 a b
ZDIFFSTORE d 2 a b
ZRANGE d 0 -1
ZINTERCARD 2 a b
ZINTERCARD 2 a b LIMIT 0
ZUNIONSTORE u 0 a
ZUNIONSTORE u 2 a b AGGREGATE BOGUS

# --- удаление и выборка ---
ZREMRANGEBYRANK a 0 0
ZRANGE a 0 -1
ZREMRANGEBYSCORE b 0 15
ZRANGE b 0 -1
ZREMRANGEBYLEX lex [a (c
ZRANGE lex 0 -1
ZPOPMIN b
ZPOPMAX b 2
ZRANDMEMBER b
ZRANDMEMBER b 1 WITHSCORES
ZRANGESTORE rs a 0 -1
ZRANGE rs 0 -1
ZRANGESTORE rs2 a 1 2 BYSCORE
ZRANGE rs2 0 -1
